overview.en: Subagent delegation supports extension-level config plus user/project settings that override default agents, models, thinking, extensions, and runtime budgets.
overview.id: Delegasi subagent mendukung konfigurasi tingkat ekstensi ditambah pengaturan user/proyek yang mengganti agent, model, thinking, ekstensi, dan anggaran runtime bawaan.

precedence.en: Lowest; applies unless overridden by user/project settings or an explicit call argument.
precedence.id: Terendah; berlaku kecuali ditimpa oleh pengaturan user/proyek atau argumen pemanggilan eksplisit.

precedence.en: Overrides extension defaults; overridden by project settings.
precedence.id: Mengganti default ekstensi; ditimpa oleh pengaturan proyek.

precedence.en: Highest persistent layer for settings-backed agent values.
precedence.id: Lapis persisten tertinggi untuk nilai agent berbasis pengaturan.

precedence.en: Explicit call arguments and agent frontmatter beat all config layers.
precedence.id: Argumen pemanggilan eksplisit dan frontmatter agent mengalahkan semua lapisan konfigurasi.

description.en: Run single subagent calls in the background by default.
description.id: Jalankan pemanggilan subagent tunggal di latar belakang secara default.

description.en: Force top-level subagent invocations to run asynchronously.
description.id: Paksakan pemanggilan subagent tingkat atas untuk berjalan secara asinkron.

description.en: Show the Claude Code-style navigable fleet panel below the editor.
description.id: Tampilkan panel fleet yang dapat dinavigasi seperti Claude Code di bawah editor.

settings.default: true when fleetView disabled, otherwise false

description.en: Show the legacy above-editor async runs widget.
description.id: Tampilkan widget async runs legacy di atas editor.

description.en: Variant of the parent-facing subagent tool description. Defaults to compact.
description.id: Varian deskripsi tool subagent yang menghadap parent. Default: compact.

description.en: Register a wait/notify tool for subagents. Pass true or { enabled: true }.
description.id: Daftarkan tool wait/notify untuk subagent. Berikan true atau { enabled: true }.

description.en: Base directory used for subagent sessions when no explicit path is given.
description.id: Direktori dasar untuk sesi subagent bila tidak ada path eksplisit.

description.en: Base directory used for single-run output artifacts.
description.id: Direktori dasar untuk artefak output single-run.

description.en: Maximum nested subagent depth for this session.
description.id: Kedalaman bersarang subagent maksimum untuk sesi ini.

description.en: Optional cumulative cap on subagent spawns across a session. 0 means unlimited.
description.id: Batas kumulatif opsional pembuatan subagent dalam satu sesi. 0 berarti tidak terbatas.

description.en: How many times an async scripted workflow may auto-relaunch with a fresh fan-out budget after exhausting it before the goal is clean. 0 means unlimited.
description.id: Berapa kali workflow berskrip async boleh me-relaunch otomatis dengan budget fan-out baru setelah budget habis sebelum goal bersih. 0 berarti tidak terbatas.

description.en: Global cap on simultaneously-running subagent tasks within a run.
description.id: Batas global tugas subagent yang berjalan bersamaan dalam satu run.

description.en: Lifecycle control notifications: enabled, thresholds (ms/turns/tokens), failed-tool count, channels (event/async/intercom), and notifyOn events.
description.id: Notifikasi kontrol siklus hidup: enabled, threshold (ms/turn/token), jumlah failed-tool, channel (event/async/intercom), dan notifyOn events.

description.en: Smart completion batching: enabled, debounceMs, maxWaitMs, stragglerDebounceMs, stragglerMaxWaitMs, stragglerWindowMs.
description.id: Pengelompokan smart completion: enabled, debounceMs, maxWaitMs, stragglerDebounceMs, stragglerMaxWaitMs, stragglerWindowMs.

description.en: Turn budget: maxTurns, optional graceTurns.
description.id: Anggaran turn: maxTurns, graceTurns opsional.

description.en: Tool budget: hard limit, optional soft limit, and optional block list or "*".
description.id: Anggaran tool: batas hard, batas soft opsional, dan daftar block atau "*" opsional.

description.en: Default maximum parallel tasks for top-level parallel runs.
description.id: Jumlah tugas paralel maksimum default untuk run paralel tingkat atas.

description.en: Default concurrency for top-level parallel runs.
description.id: Konkurensi default untuk run paralel tingkat atas.

description.en: Maximum number of dynamic items generated by a chain fan-out step.
description.id: Jumlah item maksimum yang dihasilkan oleh langkah chain fan-out dinamis.

description.en: Path to a shell command run when preparing parallel/chain worktrees.
description.id: Path ke shell command yang dijalankan saat menyiapkan worktree paralel/chain.

description.en: Timeout for the worktree setup hook.
description.id: Timeout untuk worktree setup hook.

description.en: Base directory for parallel/chain worktrees.
description.id: Direktori dasar untuk worktree paralel/chain.

description.en: Where subagent artifact files are stored.
description.id: Lokasi penyimpanan file artefak subagent.

description.en: Intercom bridge mode: off, fork-only, or always; plus optional instructionFile.
description.id: Mode intercom bridge: off, fork-only, atau always; plus instructionFile opsional.

description.en: Recommend skill-backed subagents: enabled, minReferences, maxRecommendations, preferredAgent. Set to false to disable.
description.id: Rekomendasikan subagent berbasis skill: enabled, minReferences, maxRecommendations, preferredAgent. Atur false untuk menonaktifkan.

description.en: Default model applied to built-in agents that do not declare a model. Project overrides user.
description.id: Model default untuk agent bawaan yang tidak menyatakan model. Proyek menimpa user.

description.en: Default thinking suffix applied to built-in agents without an explicit thinking value.
description.id: Suffix thinking default untuk agent bawaan tanpa nilai thinking eksplisit.

description.en: Default extensions added to agents that do not declare extensions.
description.id: Ekstensi default yang ditambahkan ke agent tanpa deklarasi ekstensi.

description.en: Disable loading of built-in agent definitions.
description.id: Nonaktifkan pemuatan definisi agent bawaan.

description.en: Disable thinking suffix defaults for built-in agents.
description.id: Nonaktifkan default suffix thinking untuk agent bawaan.

description.en: Enforce an allow-list of model patterns when enforce is true. allow is an array of glob-style patterns (only * is special).
description.id: Terapkan daftar izin pola model saat enforce true. allow adalah array pola bergaya glob (hanya * yang spesial).

description.en: Per-agent overrides for built-in agents: model, thinking, fallbackModels, tools, mcpDirectTools, extensions, subagentOnlyExtensions, skills, systemPromptMode, defaultAsync, defaultTimeoutMs, defaultTurnBudget, defaultAcceptance, acceptanceRole, output, defaultReads, defaultProgress, interactive, maxSubagentDepth, completionGuard, toolBudget, memory, disabled.
description.id: Penimpaan per agent untuk agent bawaan: model, thinking, fallbackModels, tools, mcpDirectTools, extensions, subagentOnlyExtensions, skills, systemPromptMode, defaultAsync, defaultTimeoutMs, defaultTurnBudget, defaultAcceptance, acceptanceRole, output, defaultReads, defaultProgress, interactive, maxSubagentDepth, completionGuard, toolBudget, memory, disabled.

description.en: Runtime override for the current maximum subagent depth.
description.id: Penimpaan runtime untuk kedalaman subagent maksimum saat ini.

description.en: Runtime override for max spawns per session. Use 0 for unlimited.
description.id: Penimpaan runtime untuk max spawns per sesi. Gunakan 0 untuk tidak terbatas.

description.en: Incremented automatically for nested subagent runs; do not set manually.
description.id: Dinaikkan otomatis untuk run subagent bersarang; jangan atur manual.

description.en: Forwarded to child sessions so async subagents can locate their parent.
description.id: Diteruskan ke sesi anak sehingga subagent async dapat menemukan parent-nya.

description.en: Foreground or async subagent tool call.
description.id: Pemanggilan tool subagent foreground atau async.

description.en: Slash commands for common run modes.
description.id: Slash command untuk mode run umum.

description.en: Management and monitoring commands.
description.id: Command manajemen dan monitoring.

description.en: Runtime watchdog status and controls.
description.id: Status dan kontrol watchdog runtime.

description.en: Inspect live run status and child activity.
description.id: Periksa status run dan aktivitas child.

overview.en: Web research supports layered global/project backend and presentation config, API keys stored in settings.json, and runtime command controls.
overview.id: Riset web mendukung konfigurasi backend dan presentasi global/proyek berlapis, kunci API disimpan di settings.json, dan kontrol command runtime.

precedence.en: Default lowest; overridden by project config.
precedence.id: Default terendah; ditimpa oleh konfigurasi proyek.

precedence.en: Brave API key is read from webAgent.braveApiKey. Firecrawl key can live in config or env var.
precedence.id: Kunci Brave API dibaca dari webAgent.braveApiKey. Kunci Firecrawl dapat berada di config atau variabel env.

description.en: Default presentation mode for web agent results.
description.id: Mode presentasi default untuk hasil web agent.

description.en: Per-tool presentation override.
description.id: Penimpaan presentasi per tool.

description.en: Search backend provider.
description.id: Provider backend pencarian.

description.en: Base URL for searxng or brave endpoints when required.
description.id: Base URL untuk endpoint searxng atau brave bila diperlukan.

description.en: Only valid when provider is searxng or brave. Other values are rejected.
description.id: Hanya valid saat provider adalah searxng atau brave. Nilai lain ditolak.

description.en: SearXNG categories. Must be non-empty when provided.
description.id: Kategori SearXNG. Harus tidak kosong bila diberikan.

description.en: SearXNG language. Must not be empty when provided.
description.id: Bahasa SearXNG. Tidak boleh kosong bila diberikan.

description.en: SearXNG safe-search level.
description.id: Tingkat safe-search SearXNG.

description.en: Fetch backend provider.
description.id: Provider backend fetch.

description.en: Firecrawl base URL (required for firecrawl provider).
description.id: Base URL Firecrawl (wajib untuk provider firecrawl).

description.en: Firecrawl API key. Prefer PI_WEB_AGENT_FIRECRAWL_API_KEY env var.
description.id: Kunci API Firecrawl. Utamakan variabel env PI_WEB_AGENT_FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.

description.en: Only valid when provider is firecrawl.
description.id: Hanya valid saat provider adalah firecrawl.

description.en: Firecrawl output formats. Must be non-empty when provided.
description.id: Format output Firecrawl. Harus tidak kosong bila diberikan.

description.en: Firecrawl main-content-only flag.
description.id: Flag Firecrawl hanya konten utama.

description.en: Headless escalation provider. The only supported value is local-browser.
description.id: Provider eskalasi headless. Satu-satunya nilai yang didukung adalah local-browser.

description.en: Brave Search API key stored in settings.json. Also accepts PI_WEB_AGENT_BRAVE_API_KEY env var.
description.id: Kunci API Brave Search disimpan di settings.json. Juga menerima variabel env PI_WEB_AGENT_BRAVE_API_KEY.

description.en: Override or supply the Brave API key without storing it in settings.json.
description.id: Timpa atau sediakan kunci Brave API tanpa menyimpannya di settings.json.

description.en: Override or supply the Firecrawl API key without storing it in config.json.
description.id: Timpa atau sediakan kunci Firecrawl API tanpa menyimpannya di config.json.

description.en: Agent tool that runs search, fetch, and headless escalation.
description.id: Tool agent yang menjalankan pencarian, fetch, dan eskalasi headless.

description.en: Runtime command with settings, show, doctor, changelog, reset project, and reset global subcommands.
description.id: Command runtime dengan subcommand settings, show, doctor, changelog, reset project, dan reset global.

overview.en: The question tool is schema-driven. Questions are configured per tool call; there are no persistent user settings.
overview.id: Tool question didorong schema. Pertanyaan dikonfigurasi per pemanggilan tool; tidak ada pengaturan user persisten.

precedence.en: All options are supplied by the agent inside the tool call.
precedence.id: Semua opsi diberikan oleh agent di dalam pemanggilan tool.

description.en: Stable answer id. Auto-generated when omitted.
description.id: Id jawaban yang stabil. Dibuat otomatis bila dihilangkan.

description.en: Short page label shown in the wizard.
description.id: Label halaman singkat yang ditampilkan di wizard.

description.en: Question text shown to the user.
description.id: Teks pertanyaan yang ditampilkan ke user.

description.en: Optional plain-text context shown before the question.
description.id: Konteks plain-text opsional yang ditampilkan sebelum pertanyaan.

description.en: Question type. image and info are not supported.
description.id: Tipe pertanyaan. image dan info tidak didukung.

description.en: Required for select and multiselect. Each option has value, label, and optional description.
description.id: Wajib untuk select dan multiselect. Setiap opsi memiliki value, label, dan description opsional.

description.en: Allow a custom text answer for select/multiselect.
description.id: Izinkan jawaban teks kustom untuk select/multiselect.

description.en: Batch wizard with review and submission screens.
description.id: Wizard batch dengan layar review dan submission.

overview.en: Public code search uses per-call filter and fetch options. There are no persistent user settings.
overview.id: Pencarian kode publik menggunakan opsi filter dan fetch per pemanggilan. Tidak ada pengaturan user persisten.

precedence.en: All behavior is controlled by each tool call.
precedence.id: Semua perilaku dikontrol oleh setiap pemanggilan tool.

description.en: grep.app search query.
description.id: Query pencarian grep.app.

description.en: Optional filter, e.g. language or repository.
description.id: Filter opsional, misalnya bahasa atau repository.

description.en: URL of a result to fetch.
description.id: URL hasil yang akan di-fetch.

description.en: Optional line range for fetched source.
description.id: Rentang baris opsional untuk source yang di-fetch.

description.en: Search tool and fetch tool.
description.id: Tool pencarian dan fetch.

overview.en: Intercom reads a single config file for broker command, args, confirmation, status suffix, and enable flags.
overview.id: Intercom membaca satu file konfigurasi untuk command broker, argumen, konfirmasi, suffix status, dan flag enable.

precedence.en: Only config file; no project layer.
precedence.id: Hanya file konfigurasi; tidak ada lapisan proyek.

description.en: Command used to spawn the broker process.
description.id: Command untuk menjalankan proses broker.

description.en: Arguments passed to brokerCommand before the broker script path.
description.id: Argumen yang diteruskan ke brokerCommand sebelum path skrip broker.

description.en: Require confirmation before non-reply sends in interactive sessions.
description.id: Wajibkan konfirmasi sebelum pengiriman non-reply di sesi interaktif.

description.en: Enable or disable intercom entirely.
description.id: Aktifkan atau nonaktifkan intercom sepenuhnya.

description.en: Show a reply hint in incoming messages.
description.id: Tampilkan petunjuk reply di pesan masuk.

description.en: Optional custom status suffix appended to automatic lifecycle status.
description.id: Suffix status kustom opsional yang ditambahkan ke status siklus hidup otomatis.

description.en: Send messages or replies between named local sessions.
description.id: Kirim pesan atau balasan antar sesi lokal yang diberi nama.

overview.en: Context reminder is fully automatic. The threshold and suggestion behavior are fixed.
overview.id: Pengingat konteks sepenuhnya otomatis. Threshold dan perilaku saran sudah tetap.

description.en: Fixed warning threshold. Not user-configurable.
description.id: Threshold peringatan tetap. Tidak dapat dikonfigurasi user.

description.en: Suggested command when the context threshold is crossed.
description.id: Command yang disarankan saat threshold konteks terlampaui.

overview.en: Copy turn is a command-only extension. It accepts one argument and has no persistent settings.
overview.id: Copy turn adalah ekstensi command-only. Menerima satu argumen dan tidak memiliki pengaturan persisten.

description.en: Turn hash passed as the /cp argument. Not persisted.
description.id: Hash turn yang diberikan sebagai argumen /cp. Tidak dipersisten.

description.en: Copy the content of the referenced user or assistant turn.
description.id: Salin konten turn user atau assistant yang direferensikan.

overview.en: Session handoff is controlled by the goal argument. The prompt template is source-owned.
overview.id: Handoff sesi dikontrol oleh argumen goal. Template prompt adalah milik source.

description.en: Next-focus text passed as the /handoff-new argument.
description.id: Teks fokus berikutnya yang diberikan sebagai argumen /handoff-new.

description.en: Create a continuation prompt in a fresh session.
description.id: Buat prompt kelanjutan di sesi baru.

overview.en: Undo tracks edits, writes, and mutating shell commands per turn. Retention and buffer sizes are fixed.
overview.id: Undo melacak edit, write, dan shell command bermutasi per turn. Retensi dan ukuran buffer sudah tetap.

description.en: Fixed retention limit for the undo stack. Not user-configurable.
description.id: Batas retensi tetap untuk stack undo. Tidak dapat dikonfigurasi user.

description.en: Undo the last tracked turn.
description.id: Batalkan turn terakhir yang terlacak.

description.en: Force undo when confirmation would normally be required.
description.id: Paksa undo saat konfirmasi biasanya diperlukan.

overview.en: Optional Rewind reads all settings from the rewind key in settings.json. It has no standalone /rewind command.
overview.id: Rewind opsional membaca semua pengaturan dari kunci rewind di settings.json. Tidak ada command /rewind mandiri.

precedence.en: All Rewind settings live under rewind.*.
precedence.id: Semua pengaturan Rewind berada di bawah rewind.*.

description.en: Hide footer/status and checkpoint notifications.
description.id: Sembunyikan footer/status dan notifikasi checkpoint.

description.en: Optional cap on unpinned unique snapshot commits kept reachable.
description.id: Batas opsional pada commit snapshot unik yang tidak dipin dan tetap reachable.

description.en: Optional age limit in days for unpinned snapshot commits.
description.id: Batas usia opsional dalam hari untuk commit snapshot yang tidak dipin.

description.en: Keep snapshots bound to labeled nodes exempt from maxSnapshots/maxAgeDays pruning.
description.id: Pertahankan snapshot yang terikat ke node labeled agar tidak dipangkas oleh maxSnapshots/maxAgeDays.

description.en: Retention discovery mode: follow current session lineage only, or scan discovered session roots.
description.id: Mode discovery retensi: hanya ikuti silsilah sesi saat ini, atau pindai root sesi yang ditemukan.

description.en: Optional startup time budget for retention sweeps. Exceeded sweeps are skipped and deferred.
description.id: Anggaran waktu startup opsional untuk sweep retensi. Sweep yang melebihi dilewati dan ditunda.

description.en: Rewind triggers automatically during fork and tree navigation.
description.id: Rewind dipicu otomatis saat navigasi fork dan tree.

overview.en: Token onboarding uses environment suppression, an onboarding marker, and account storage. Credentials are sensitive values stored locally.
overview.id: Onboarding token menggunakan penekanan env, marker onboarding, dan penyimpanan akun. Kredensial adalah nilai sensitif yang disimpan secara lokal.

precedence.en: Marker file and multi-account tokenin-auth.json live here.
precedence.id: File marker dan tokenin-auth.json multi-akun berada di sini.

description.en: Written when onboarding is complete so the prompt does not reappear.
description.id: Ditulis saat onboarding seelsai agar prompt tidak muncul lagi.

description.en: Multi-account TokenIN storage. Written with mode 0o600.
description.id: Penyimpanan TokenIN multi-akun. Ditulis dengan mode 0o600.

description.en: Legacy models.json key removed during onboarding.
description.id: Kunci models.json legacy dihapus selama onboarding.

description.en: Set to 1 to disable the first-run TokenIN onboarding prompt.
description.id: Atur ke 1 untuk menonaktifkan prompt onboarding TokenIN pertama kali.

description.en: Manage stored TokenIN accounts and show quota usage.
description.id: Kelola akun TokenIN yang tersimpan dan tampilkan penggunaan kuota.

overview.en: Web-agent onboarding writes the Brave API key to settings and generates a Brave backend override. It can be re-run via /setup-web-search.
overview.id: Onboarding web agent menulis kunci API Brave ke pengaturan dan membuat override backend Brave. Dapat dijalankan ulang via /setup-web-search.

precedence.en: Marker file, settings.json key, and pi-web-agent backend config are written here.
precedence.id: File marker, kunci settings.json, dan konfigurasi backend pi-web-agent ditulis di sini.

description.en: Written when onboarding completes.
description.id: Ditulis saat onboarding selesai.

description.en: Brave Search API key stored in settings.json.
description.id: Kunci API Brave Search disimpan di settings.json.

description.en: Generated backend override with DuckDuckGo fallback.
description.id: Override backend yang dibuat dengan fallback DuckDuckGo.

description.en: Set to 1 to disable the first-run web-agent onboarding prompt.
description.id: Atur ke 1 untuk menonaktifkan prompt onboarding web agent pertama kali.

description.en: Re-run the Brave Search onboarding flow and reload extensions.
description.id: Jalankan ulang alur onboarding Brave Search dan muat ulang ekstensi.

overview.en: Core llama.cpp model management is configured via provider auth and slash commands. It is a hidden built-in extension, not a manifest entry.
overview.id: Manajemen model llama.cpp inti dikonfigurasi melalui auth provider dan slash command. Ini adalah ekstensi bawaan tersembunyi, bukan entri manifest.

precedence.en: Credentials and base URL are stored via the model registry's provider auth flow.
precedence.id: Kredensial dan base URL disimpan melalui alur auth provider model registry.

description.en: Llama.cpp server URL. /login stores the URL in provider auth env.LLAMA_BASE_URL. At runtime, LLAMA_BASE_URL env var (if set) takes precedence over that stored value.
description.id: URL server llama.cpp. /login menyimpan URL di provider auth env.LLAMA_BASE_URL. Saat runtime, variabel env LLAMA_BASE_URL (jika diatur) didahulukan daripada nilai yang tersimpan.

description.en: Optional API key for the llama.cpp server. Stored in provider auth; falls back to LLAMA_API_KEY env var at runtime if no stored key exists.
description.id: Kunci API opsional untuk server llama.cpp. Disimpan di provider auth; fallback ke variabel env LLAMA_API_KEY saat runtime jika tidak ada kunci tersimpan.

description.en: Highest-priority runtime override for the configured llama.cpp server URL. Also used as the default during /login if no URL is entered.
description.id: Override runtime prioritas tertinggi untuk URL server llama.cpp yang dikonfigurasi. Juga digunakan sebagai default saat /login jika tidak ada URL yang dimasukkan.

description.en: Runtime fallback API key for the llama.cpp server.
description.id: Fallback kunci API runtime untuk server llama.cpp.

description.en: Hugging Face token used to search and download gated models.
description.id: Token Hugging Face untuk mencari dan mengunduh model gated.

description.en: Configure base URL and optional API key for the llama.cpp provider.
description.id: Konfigurasikan base URL dan kunci API opsional untuk provider llama.cpp.

description.en: Open the TUI model manager. Only available in interactive mode.
description.id: Buka pengelola model TUI. Hanya tersedia dalam mode interaktif.

overview.en: Inline skills depend on installed skill files. The # token and autocomplete behavior are fixed; there are no persistent settings.
overview.id: Skill inline bergantung pada file skill yang terpasang. Token # dan perilaku autocomplete sudah tetap; tidak ada pengaturan persisten.

description.en: Inline invitations only work when matching skill files exist.
description.id: Ajakan inline hanya berfungsi saat file skill yang cocok ada.

description.en: Type # followed by a skill name to trigger autocomplete.
description.id: Ketik # diikuti nama skill untuk memicu autocomplete.

description.en: Legacy inline skill invitation syntax.
description.id: Sintaks ajakan skill inline legacy.

overview.en: Ponytail's default mode is resolved from environment, then config file, then the built-in default. Session commands can switch mode without persisting it.
overview.id: Mode default Ponytail di-resolve dari environment, lalu file config, lalu default bawaan. Command sesi dapat mengganti mode tanpa mempersistennya.

precedence.en: XDG_CONFIG_HOME takes precedence; falls back to POSIX or Windows paths.
precedence.id: XDG_CONFIG_HOME didahulukan; fallback ke path POSIX atau Windows.

description.en: Default communication mode. "review" is treated as "full" when persisted.
description.id: Mode komunikasi default. "review" diperlakukan sebagai "full" saat dipersisten.

description.en: Highest-priority override for the default mode.
description.id: Override prioritas tertinggi untuk mode default.

description.en: Invoke Ponytail skills.
description.id: Panggil skill Ponytail.

description.en: Persist the current session's mode to the config file.
description.id: Persistenkan mode sesi saat ini ke file config.

description.en: Whole-message deactivation phrases.
description.id: Frasa deaktivasi seluruh pesan.

overview.en: RTK is managed by Selesai when needed. The extension rewrites commands when a verified rtk binary is available and not disabled.
overview.id: RTK dikelola oleh Selesai saat diperlukan. Ekstensi menulis ulang command saat biner rtk terverifikasi tersedia dan tidak dinonaktifkan.

description.en: Required rtk version; Selesai reuses PATH or its managed binary directory.
description.id: Versi rtk yang diperlukan; Selesai menggunakan PATH atau direktori biner terkelola.

description.en: Transparent; no user command required.
description.id: Transparan; tidak diperlukan command user.

description.en: Set this environment variable to disable RTK command rewriting and managed installation for the session.
description.id: Atur variabel lingkungan ini untuk menonaktifkan penulisan ulang command RTK dan instalasi terkelola untuk sesi ini.

description.en: Set this environment variable to disable startup network operations, preventing managed binary downloads.
description.id: Atur variabel lingkungan ini untuk menonaktifkan operasi jaringan saat startup, mencegah pengunduhan biner terkelola.

overview.en: Agent-browser setup is prompt-driven: Selesai offers to install the external CLI when it is missing. The install flow can be skipped or re-run; there are no persistent settings.
overview.id: Setup agent-browser didorong prompt: Selesai menawarkan instalasi CLI eksternal saat belum ada. Alur instalasi dapat dilewati atau dijalankan ulang; tidak ada pengaturan persisten.

description.en: Optional global npm CLI. Selesai offers to install and provision it on first startup when missing.
description.id: CLI npm global opsional. Selesai menawarkan untuk menginstal dan menyediakannya saat startup pertama jika belum ada.

description.en: Set this environment variable to skip the automated setup prompt.
description.id: Atur variabel lingkungan ini untuk melewati prompt setup otomatis.

description.en: Re-run the install flow any time, including after declining.
description.id: Jalankan ulang alur instalasi kapan saja, termasuk setelah menolak.

overview.en: A bundled parent-only skill that chooses the smallest safe pi-subagents implementation flow.
overview.id: Skill bawaan khusus parent yang memilih alur implementasi pi-subagents aman yang paling kecil.

precedence.en: The parent adapts stages to the task; no user configuration file controls the flow.
precedence.id: Parent menyesuaikan tahap dengan tugas; tidak ada file konfigurasi user yang mengontrol alur.

description.en: Apply adaptive implementation orchestration guidance.
description.id: Terapkan panduan orkestrasi implementasi adaptif.

overview.en: Zentui configures independent editor, user-message, thinking, working-line, footer, segment, git, and extension surfaces from one zentui.json, with live /zentui pickers.
overview.id: Zentui mengonfigurasi permukaan editor, pesan user, thinking, working line, footer, segmen, git, dan ekstensi yang independen dari satu zentui.json, dengan picker /zentui langsung.

precedence.en: Single file written by /zentui; no project layer.
precedence.id: Satu file yang ditulis /zentui; tidak ada lapisan proyek.

description.en: Editor surface: opencode, opencode-copy-friendly, accent-rail, or minimalist.
description.id: Permukaan editor: opencode, opencode-copy-friendly, accent-rail, atau minimalist.

description.en: Footer style: native, starship, or hidden.
description.id: Gaya footer: native, starship, atau hidden.

description.en: User-message style: framed, framed-copy-friendly, compact, or labeled.
description.id: Gaya pesan user: framed, framed-copy-friendly, compact, atau labeled.

description.en: Take over Pi's complete working-line row and settled turn summary.
description.id: Ambil alih baris working line lengkap Pi dan ringkasan turn yang selesai.

description.en: Starship footer path display: basename, full, or repository.
description.id: Tampilan path footer starship: basename, full, atau repository.

description.en: Opt-in private thinking renderer (Rail, Tree, or Streaming); experimental and may break after Pi updates.
description.id: Renderer thinking privat opsional (Rail, Tree, atau Streaming); eksperimental dan dapat rusak setelah pembaruan Pi.

description.en: Thinking mode: rail, tree, or streaming.
description.id: Mode thinking: rail, tree, atau streaming.

description.en: Open the live configuration picker; changes save to zentui.json.
description.id: Buka picker konfigurasi langsung; perubahan disimpan ke zentui.json.

description.en: Toggle the editor surface without opening the picker.
description.id: Toggle permukaan editor tanpa membuka picker.

description.en: Toggle user-message framing without opening the picker.
description.id: Toggle framing pesan user tanpa membuka picker.

description.en: Configure working-line takeover and turn summary.
description.id: Konfigurasikan pengambilalihan working line dan ringkasan turn.

description.en: Set the compact footer format template.
description.id: Atur template format footer compact.

overview.en: The TPS tracker is automatic: it listens to message and tool events, shows live tok/s in the status area, and needs no configuration.
overview.id: Pelacak TPS bersifat otomatis: mendengarkan event message dan tool, menampilkan tok/s langsung di area status, dan tidak memerlukan konfigurasi.

description.en: Live tokens-per-second for the main model and subagent runs; fixed reliability gates, not user-configurable.
description.id: Token-per-detik langsung untuk model utama dan run subagent; gate keandalan tetap, tidak dapat dikonfigurasi user.

overview.en: Auto session naming is automatic: on every user message it asks the current model for a short name using only user-message history, and never blocks the message send.
overview.id: Penamaan sesi otomatis bersifat otomatis: pada setiap pesan user ia meminta nama singkat ke model saat ini hanya dari riwayat pesan user, dan tidak pernah memblokir pengiriman pesan.

overview.en: Cost reconciliation is automatic: it captures provider-reported costs from LLM responses and records them as session entries; the zentui footer prefers them over rate-card estimates.
overview.id: Rekonsiliasi biaya bersifat otomatis: ia menangkap biaya yang dilaporkan provider dari respons LLM dan mencatatnya sebagai entri sesi; footer zentui mengutamakannya daripada estimasi rate card.

overview.en: Tool display configures compact tool rendering, diff views, output truncation, and the native user message box from one config.json, with /tool-display presets.
overview.id: Tool display mengonfigurasi rendering tool ringkas, tampilan diff, pemotongan output, dan kotak pesan user native dari satu config.json, dengan preset /tool-display.

precedence.en: Single user-level file written by /tool-display; no project layer.
precedence.id: Satu file tingkat user yang ditulis /tool-display; tidak ada lapisan proyek.

description.en: Read tool output mode: hidden, summary, or preview.
description.id: Mode output tool read: hidden, summary, atau preview.

description.en: Search tool output mode: hidden, count, or preview.
description.id: Mode output tool search: hidden, count, atau preview.

description.en: Bash output mode: opencode, summary, or preview.
description.id: Mode output bash: opencode, summary, atau preview.

description.en: Lines shown in preview mode.
description.id: Baris yang ditampilkan dalam mode preview.

description.en: Draw an ASCII border around each tool call and its output.
description.id: Gambar border ASCII di sekitar setiap panggilan tool dan outputnya.

description.en: Use the native user message box.
description.id: Gunakan kotak pesan user native.

description.en: Show the effective config summary.
description.id: Tampilkan ringkasan konfigurasi efektif.

description.en: Apply a rendering preset.
description.id: Terapkan preset rendering.

description.en: Reset to the default boxed preset.
description.id: Reset ke preset boxed bawaan.

overview.en: Persistent memory stores facts, preferences, corrections, and skills across sessions, with session search and configurable review/flush behavior.
overview.id: Memori persisten menyimpan fakta, preferensi, koreksi, dan skill lintas sesi, dengan pencarian sesi serta perilaku review/flush yang dapat dikonfigurasi.

precedence.en: Memory, skills, and the SQLite search store live under the Selesai agent directory; project memories are per project under projects-memory/.
precedence.id: Memori, skill, dan store pencarian SQLite berada di direktori agent Selesai; memori proyek per proyek di bawah projects-memory/.

description.en: How the memory policy is injected into the system prompt.
description.id: Cara kebijakan memori disuntikkan ke system prompt.

description.en: Enables background review nudges and session flush.
description.id: Mengaktifkan nudge review latar belakang dan session flush.

description.en: direct (in-process completeSimple) or subprocess (pi -p) for LLM-driven memory operations.
description.id: direct (completeSimple in-process) atau subprocess (pi -p) untuk operasi memori berbasis LLM.

description.en: legacy snippet search or anchors mode reading session JSONL directly.
description.id: Pencarian snippet legacy atau mode anchors yang membaca session JSONL langsung.

description.en: Show everything stored in memory and the user profile.
description.id: Tampilkan semua yang tersimpan di memori dan profil user.

description.en: Open the interactive skills manager.
description.id: Buka pengelola skill interaktif.

description.en: Manually trigger memory consolidation.
description.id: Picu konsolidasi memori secara manual.

description.en: Pre-fill the user profile with a few questions.
description.id: Isi profil user dengan beberapa pertanyaan.

description.en: List project memories and entry counts.
description.id: Daftar memori proyek dan jumlah entri.

description.en: Import past Pi sessions into the search database.
description.id: Impor sesi Pi masa lalu ke database pencarian.

description.en: Backfill Markdown memories into the SQLite search store.
description.id: Backfill memori Markdown ke store pencarian SQLite.

description.en: Preview the memory policy blocks appended to the system prompt.
description.id: Pratinjau blok kebijakan memori yang ditambahkan ke system prompt.

description.en: Skill that teaches how to use the memory system.
description.id: Skill yang mengajarkan cara memakai sistem memori.

overview.en: Herdr pane state is fully automatic and environment-driven. It activates only when HERDR_ENV=1 with HERDR_SOCKET_PATH and HERDR_PANE_ID set.
overview.id: Status pane Herdr sepenuhnya otomatis dan digerakkan lingkungan. Aktif hanya saat HERDR_ENV=1 dengan HERDR_SOCKET_PATH dan HERDR_PANE_ID diatur.

description.en: Must be 1 for the extension to activate.
description.id: Harus 1 agar ekstensi aktif.

description.en: Local Unix-domain socket path for pane reports.
description.id: Path socket Unix lokal untuk laporan pane.

description.en: Pane identifier the reports are attributed to.
description.id: Identitas pane tempat laporan diatribusikan.
